'''New Agamar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE" /> located in the [[New Agamar system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet shared its name with another planet in the Outer Rim, [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

New Agamar was noted for its high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], and therefore the [[Human/Legends|human]] settlers who [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the world evolved over time to be much stockier and more muscular than most humans.<ref name="CE" /> At least [[Dondo Foth|one]] native was enlisted in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic military]] by the [[19 BBY/Legends|end of the]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
New Agamar was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Jedi Trial]]'', written by [[David Sherman]] and [[Dan Cragg]].<ref name="JT" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[New Agamar system/Legends|New Agamar star system]] and the planet itself in grid square N-5.<ref name="EA" />
